title: VTA events — shared definitions for the vta/events/* spec family
description:
Events a VTA holds for its principal outside any community (VTI Events Hosted by a Person chapter, VTI-PEV-*). Not itself a Trust Task specification (the `_shared` folder is skipped by the registry build and the codegen).

THE HOST IS A PERSONA. An event is held in the trust context of the persona identifier it is held under; invitations name that identifier as the thing's holder (VTI-PEV-001, VTI-NTF-068).

INVITEES ONLY. Invitations go only to contacts the principal names, and invitee operations are accepted only from the identifier an invitation in force names (VTI-PEV-010, VTI-PEV-020).

REUSE. Time, kind, lifecycle, registration settings, access details, registration status and the event summary are the vtc/events family's own shapes.

VtaEventContextId.title: VtaEventContextId
VtaEventContextId.description: A trust context of the VTA, by its identifier.

VtaEventDid.title: VtaEventDid
VtaEventDid.description: A DID: the event's host (a persona identifier the principal holds), or an invitee's identifier.

VtaEventRoster.title: VtaEventRoster
VtaEventRoster.description: The roster setting of an event a VTA holds: `visible`, in which registrants who are `going` or `maybe` see one another by display name; or `hidden`, in which no registrant sees another. Fixed at publish (VTI-EVT-051). A VTA offers no `anonymous` (VTI-PEV-002).

VtaEventDisplayName.title: VtaEventDisplayName
VtaEventDisplayName.description: The name a registrant asks to be shown by on a `visible` roster. Never their identifier (VTI-PEV-024).

VtaEventReminderList.title: VtaEventReminderList
VtaEventReminderList.description: Reminder offsets the host suggests, in minutes before the start, distinct. The invitee's own VTA decides whether to use them (VTI-CAL-041).

VtaEvent.title: VtaEvent
VtaEvent.description: An event a VTA holds for its principal, outside any community (VTI-PEV-001). As the principal's clients see it.

contextId.description: The trust context the event is held in: the host's (VTI-PEV-001).

host.description: The persona identifier the event is held under. Invitations name it as the thing's holder (VTI-NTF-068) and invitees address it.

access.description: Released only to the principal and to invitees whose registration is `going` (VTI-PEV-024). Present only in vta/events/show.

goingCount.description: Places taken: `going` registrations and their guests.

full.description: True when `going` registrations and their guests reach `capacity`.

sequence.description: Raised on every change of time, access details, status or kind after publication (VTI-EVT-006).

VtaEventInviteeView.title: VtaEventInviteeView
VtaEventInviteeView.description: An event as an invitee sees it: no access details (those are vta/events/invitee/access/show, to `going` registrants), no counts of invitations and no other invitee (VTI-PEV-041).

full.description: True when no place is free. Never the count itself.

VtaEventInvitationId.title: VtaEventInvitationId
VtaEventInvitationId.description: An invitation's identifier at its host.

VtaEventInvitationStatus.title: VtaEventInvitationStatus
VtaEventInvitationStatus.description: `active`: in force; its `event` notification stands. `revoked`: the principal revoked it, or the invitee ceased to be a contact of the host; its notification is withdrawn (VTI-PEV-012).

VtaEventInvitation.title: VtaEventInvitation
VtaEventInvitation.description: One invitation: a contact of the host the principal named (VTI-PEV-010).

invitee.description: The invitee's identifier: the notification's audience and the only signer the host accepts invitee operations from for this event (VTI-PEV-020).

VtaEventRegistration.title: VtaEventRegistration
VtaEventRegistration.description: An invitee's registration for an event a VTA holds. At most one per invitee per event (VTI-EVT-030).

registrantDid.description: The invitee's identifier. Shown to the principal and the registrant alone (VTI-PEV-024).

answers.description: Present only to the principal and the registrant (VTI-PEV-041).

roster.description: The roster setting the registration was made under (VTI-EVT-052).

eventSequence.description: The event's `sequence` when the registration last changed.

note.description: A note the principal gave with a decision, shown to the registrant.

VtaEventRosterEntry.title: VtaEventRosterEntry
VtaEventRosterEntry.description: Another registrant on a `visible` roster: their display name if they gave one, their state and guests, and nothing else of them (VTI-PEV-024).

VtaEventMine.title: VtaEventMine
VtaEventMine.description: One of the signer's registrations at the host addressed, with the event as it stands (VTI-PEV-031).
